name: Photo Frame
summary: Photo frames to print for an instant print or a paper photo: rectangles, arches, scallops, ric-rac and squiggles, with words, a crest, bold patterns and a stand; song plaques, social posts, and ledges, pebbles and hearts a print stands in.
credits: Feature set after the Vostok Labs Photo Frames Studio; every shape, pattern and stand written for Print Factory.
